Local SEO · Southwest Florida

Be the business Florida customers find first.

Local SEO for Fort Myers, Naples and Cape Coral businesses that want to show up in Google Maps and search results when customers are ready to buy.

Book a Strategy Call → Take the Growth Scorecard →

Your customers are searching. Are they finding you?

When someone in Cape Coral searches “kitchen remodeler near me” or “pool builder Naples,” they call one of the first three businesses they see. Local SEO is how you become one of them — and stay there.

01 — What’s included

What Local SEO growth includes

01

Google Business Profile optimization

Categories, services, photos, posts and Q&A — the profile that powers map results.

02

Service and location pages

Pages built for real searches in the areas you serve, with local proof on every page.

03

Reviews and reputation

A simple system to ask happy customers for reviews and respond professionally.

04

Technical SEO

Speed, indexing, structured data and site health, so Google understands every page.

05

Local authority

Consistent listings, local partnerships and mentions that build trust with Google and customers.

06

Reporting that matters

Monthly reporting on calls, form requests and direction requests — not just rankings.

02 — Expectations

An honest word on SEO

No one can guarantee rankings, and anyone who does is guessing. What I promise is a clear plan, consistent execution and transparent reporting. Most local businesses see meaningful movement within 3–6 months, depending on competition.
